title: Giants on the Rime
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.Old Varga grew up on her grandmother's stories of the winter the frost giants came south. Now they have come again.

About

Given byOld Varga
Level23
LengthMedium
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

Nothing to bring in the steps recorded so far.

Steps

  1. Talk to Old Varga (outdoors around -275, -1005) to get the quest.
  2. Frost giants on the Rime (10)
  3. Report to Old Varga at -275, -1005

Rewards

Reward
Gold2,304
Character XP72,000
Quest points1

What Old Varga says

You: Ten frost giants are dead on the Rime.

Old Varga: Ten! My grandmother would have liked you.

Old Varga: Elder Brunna has been hearing horns out there at night. She's in Thane's Hall. Go and ask her about them.

Handing it in

"Elder Brunna has been hearing horns out there at night. She's in Thane's Hall. Go and ask her about them."
